visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor souvenir shop setting. A woman with light brown hair in a bun, wearing a floral patterned dress and an orangutan plush backpack, stands amidst shelves packed with various stuffed animals. The background is brightly lit with warm indoor lights and festive decorations. (2) Close-up shot focusing on a brown and white bird plush toy on a shelf. A hand reaches out and picks it up, revealing a red crest on its head. Other similar plush toys are arranged in the background. (3) The woman walks through the store aisles, carrying the bird plush. The camera follows from a side-back angle. Rows of colorful souvenirs, clothes, and more plushies are visible on shelves and racks. (4) Inside the store, the woman holds several blue postcards in one hand and the bird plush in the other. She looks towards the person filming with a curious and slightly amused expression. (5) Close-up of a checkout counter. The bird plush and postcards are placed on the surface. A hand holds a smartphone near a Verifone payment terminal. A female store clerk in a black uniform is partially visible. (6) Outdoor scene in daylight. The woman is holding the bird plush in front of a background of green trees, a paved parking area with cars, and a blue and white flag on a pole. (7) Close-up of the woman outdoors, smiling and laughing while looking at the bird plush. She brings the toy close to her face as if kissing it. The lighting is natural and bright from the sun. (8) Transition to an indoor bedroom environment with soft, warm lighting. The woman is shown from the chest up, holding the bird plush and the postcards, speaking directly toward the camera with a playful expression.

The voices overlap as the female speaker reacts with increased pitch variability and excitement. (3) A distinct, sharp electronic 'beep' occurs, characteristic of a payment terminal confirming a transaction. The BGM remains steady in the background.
